title: Graph-Independent Identification from Surrogate Experiments over Completions of a Three-Node PAG
banked_reason: Stage 0.5: delivered tier incremental below the fixed field floor; mathematics and citations pass, but no honest bounded same-topic repair reaches field.
gap_reasons: The proved contribution is confined to one finite three-node PAG, an exhaustive nine-completion case split, and an explicit sufficient repair; it does not supply a general uniform-gID principle or a complete characterization even on its own constant-kernel ambiguity locus.

The repeated description of the augmented interface as ‘minimal’ is not established: the repair theorem proves that one do(Y) marginal suffices, while the two-node theorem concerns minimal graph size and does not prove necessity of that repair information.
Likewise, the ambient-simplex codimension calculation says nothing about genericity inside the compatible-source image, so it cannot support a stronger frontier interpretation.
proof_attempt_summary: The run proved a sound finite-state three-node separation: every one of nine PAG completions separately identifies the target from observation plus do(X,Y), while two positive source-equivalent SCMs in the unindexed union disagree; it also proved two-node minimality, contrast preservation, and a sufficient one-regime repair. The field-tier claim collapsed because the constant-kernel branch-realizability/identified-set frontier and necessity of the repair information were not characterized. Reaching field would require a new latent response-function compatibility theory and a principled information order, so the validity gate classified that work as a re-anchor rather than a bounded repair.
tldr: For the positive finite three-node noncollider-path PAG, every one of the nine compatible causal ADMGs is a successful fixed-graph positive-gID instance from observation and the complete \(\operatorname{do}(X,Y)\) source, yet two source-equivalent bowed completions have absolute target values \(15/32\) and \(1/2\), so no graph-independent functional exists. The witness pair is also a subclass counterexample inside the corresponding full Jaber-style recursive PAG union. Three variables are minimal for this separate-success/union-failure phenomenon; all treatment contrasts remain identified; ambiguity can occur only on the constant-kernel diagonal, whose ambient codimension is \((|X_{\mathrm{space}}||Y_{\mathrm{space}}|-1)(|Z_{\mathrm{space}}|-1)\); and one mediator marginal from one fixed \(\operatorname{do}(Y=\eta)\) regime repairs the absolute target.
gap: Complete PAG identification from observation and complete positive gID for a fixed graph do not compose automatically. The literature supplies the requirement of one class-valid estimator and separately supplies fixed-graph experimental identification, but does not establish whether successful graphwise calls align on the overlapping images of unindexed experimental sources.
fill: Define the bowed causal projection separately from the inducing-path MAG projection, prove their intervention-relevant reduction, enumerate the nine compatible causal completions, derive their two target formulas, certify the positive cross-completion witnesses, rule out every two-node analogue, characterize the contrast and ambiguity boundary, and prove the completion-invariant repair identity for arbitrary finite observed alphabets.
